usedFor: Slack knows who joins, and Loops.so adds them through “Create a contact in mailing list”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User Joined or Updated in Your Org” in Slack, then “Create a contact in mailing list” in Loops.so
bestTemplate.why: Each new teammate lands in your Loops.so mailing list without anyone adding them by hand.

watchOut: That trigger also fires on updates, so one person can reach “Create a contact in mailing list” twice.
